entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to request a UE to provide specific identification parameters such as IMSI or IMEI.

entities.name: International Mobile Subscriber Identity
entities.description: Identification parameter that can be requested by the network during the identification procedure. Defined in 3GPP TS 23.003.

entities.name: International Mobile Equipment Identity
entities.description: Identification parameter that can be requested by the network during the identification procedure. Defined in 3GPP TS 23.003. A single IMEI is used for devices supporting both 3GPP and cdma2000 access.

entities.name: MUSIM UE condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE is a MUSIM UE, requiring the use of separate IMEI for each USIM the UE operates.

relations.description: The identification procedure can request the IMSI identification parameter from the UE.
The identification procedure can request the IMEI identification parameter from the UE.
When the UE is a MUSIM UE, it uses separate IMEI for each USIM.
